HMPV virus has been detected in an eight-month-old girl at Bangalore's Baptist Hospital. 

However the health department says that we have not tested it in our lab. A case has been reported from a private hospital. Hence the health department is not giving a formal confirmation. https://t.co/4bdAsPclLG
